recentItems.title: Indira Gandhi’s Emergency: The Darkest 21 Months in Indian History? | Suresh Kochattil | iDream
recentItems.description:
#idreamnews #idreamupdates #idreammediainterviews #teluguinterviews 
Indira Gandhi’s Emergency: The Darkest 21 Months in Indian History? | Suresh Kochattil | iDream
#IndiraGandhi #Emergency1975 #IndianHistory #IndianPolitics #SureshKochattil #iDream


What really happened during the Emergency imposed by Indira Gandhi in 1975? Why did India’s democracy face one of its biggest challenges? From the Allahabad High Court verdict and JP Movement to mass arrests, press censorship, forced sterilizations and the shocking 1977 election defeat, discover the untold political story behind one of the darkest chapters in Indian history.
In this special episode of iDream Turning Points, host Kavitha speaks with senior journalist Suresh Kochattil about the real reasons behind the Emergency, its impact on ordinary citizens and the lessons it left for Indian democracy.
